title: EasyRemeltingV1.0
description: Datapack, which represents the possibility of melting ore blocks into a metal block.
body:
![EasyRemeltincPack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cbeef310a1132d225f4637a33d45eeb2548dca3.png)
You can now easily melt any block of ore metal! You will not reduce the time of melting metals, but you will reduce the space spent:  by compressing the resource by 9 times. This datapack is available for versions in the range from 1.17 to 1.20. 1.21: soon.

Supported mods: Create, Mekanism, Beyond earth, Thermal, Tconstruct, Immersive engineering.

The list of mods will be updated!

How to install EasyRemelting V1 DATAPACK

Open the game Select the world in which you want to install the data pack, and click "Configure"
Click "Open the world folder"
Open the "datapacks" folder and unzip the archive into it
Done
